'''''Rampant''''' was a [[Victory-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Victory''-class Star Destroyer]] in the service of the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].<ref name="EAW" /> It was damaged during a [[Boeus sector campaign|campaign]] against the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] in the [[Boeus sector/Legends|Boeus sector]], around [[2 ABY/Legends|2 ABY]]. When it was berthed at the [[Wroona Stardock]] for repairs, its port-most [[Ion engine/Legends|ion drive]] exploded in an [[Raid on the Wroona Stardock|attack]] by [[Wroonian/Legends|Wroonian]] outlaw [[Kabalard Vinne]], a former representative of the [[Guild of Armament Distributors]]. Vinne said the sabotage was a response to Governor [[Norrin]]'s recent crackdown on some of the less legitimate Wroonian guilds.<ref name="GNN9">{{JournalCite|9|Galaxywide NewsNets}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
''Rampant'' is one of several names in the class-specific lists from which the video games ''[[Star Wars: Empire at War]]'' and its expansion [[Star Wars: Empire at War: Forces of Corruption|''Forces of Corruption'']] randomly select names for capital ships.
